returnHomeEnding.note: Defeating the Prince only opens Return Home. Existing ending commit/complete flow remains a separate player decision.

options.title: Activity Core
options.implementability: uses existing counter.v1 Activity without a new combat subsystem

explicitBegin.playerAction: Press a dedicated 'Confront the Prince' Activity entry button

sequence.routeModel: One explicit approach route, followed by several one-use options; optional item/relationship-supported options can improve progress/endurance efficiency but never gate success.
sequence.saveReload: Native ActivityEnvelope persists activityId, progress, endurance, steps, routeId, resolvedOptionIds, checkpoint, and rngState. Reload resumes the same attempt.

reusedMechanics: existing Activity UI and save envelope

failureRefusalRetry.refusal: Use built-in escape action; no defeat signal.
failureRefusalRetry.failure: End with failure outcome; no defeat signal.
failureRefusalRetry.retry: Because failurePolicy is exit_to_day and readiness remains true, the player may explicitly enter a new attempt later. A new ActivityEnvelope starts from progress 0.

avoidsSingleAutomaticCheck: Player must choose an approach and make multiple Activity decisions.
Success depends on authored progress/endurance sequencing rather than a one-shot stat roll.
No chance field or generic combat roll is required.
options.returnHomeSeparation: Activity success adds prince-defeated only. The Return Home ending becomes eligible afterward and is committed separately through the existing ending UI.
optionalSupportExamples: itemCapability branches such as guard_sealed_pass / artist_handle_invitation / merchant_verify_manifest / assassin_handle_evidence
Palace relationship facts from patron/rival/official-contact routes when those v5 relationships are integrated
productionTouches: src/ui/app.ts: expose Palace Activity entry in an authorized Palace-facing panel or activity list
optional presentation mapping/media after topology/presentation ownership is decided

options.title: Quest-backed Latched Event Chain
options.implementability: uses existing quest state machine + action + latched blocking events

explicitBegin.playerAction: Press a dedicated story action 'Confront the Prince'

suggestedFlow: begin action advances quest ready -> confronting
finish writes prince-defeated and advances quest confronting -> defeated
sequence.saveReload: Quest stage is serialized; each pending/latched event snapshot is serialized. Reload resumes the exact pending scene/allowed choices.

failureRefusalRetry.refusal: A withdraw choice advances quest confronting -> ready and writes no defeat signal.
failureRefusalRetry.failure: An authored unsuccessful resolution advances quest confronting -> ready and writes no defeat signal.
failureRefusalRetry.retry: The explicit begin action becomes available again while stage=ready. Event maxShows must allow the approved retry budget rather than being one-shot.

avoidsSingleAutomaticCheck: Readiness only unlocks the begin action.
At least three authored scenes require explicit choices.
Optional item/relationship conditions change available responses but do not auto-win.
Final defeat is written only by the successful terminal choice.
options.returnHomeSeparation: Successful event chain writes prince-defeated and leaves the run active. Return Home eligibility then registers, and the player separately commits the ending.
optionalSupportExamples: relationshipStage / relationshipFact choices from generic Palace relationships
itemCapability alternatives for evidence, formal access, sealed access, or invitation handling
productionTouches: content/definitions.json: add confrontation quest machine and one story action
src/ui/app.ts: expose the explicit Palace story action in an authorized Palace-facing panel

options.title: Authored Prelude + Activity Core + Verdict
options.implementability: combines existing authored event resolver with counter.v1 Activity and an activityResult follow-up

availability.mechanism: story action opens confrontation, then Activity entry is conditioned on a run-local open fact

explicitBegin.playerAction: Press a dedicated 'Begin the final confrontation' story action

sequence.expectedPlayerSteps: 1 prelude choice + 3-6 Activity choices + 1 verdict choice
phases: prelude event records selected approach/support and adds palace.prince-confrontation-open
latched verdict event asks player to stand by the successful outcome
sequence.saveReload: Prelude fact/choices, ActivityEnvelope, activityResult-triggered latched verdict, and pending verdict are all stored in existing run state.

princeDefeatedSignal.emittedBy: final verdict choice after Activity success

failureRefusalRetry.refusal: Prelude can offer 'Not yet' without opening the Activity.
failureRefusalRetry.failure: Activity failure/escape clears the Activity and writes no defeat signal; confrontation-open may remain so the player can retry without replaying the prelude, or be cleared if Product wants a full reset.
failureRefusalRetry.retry: Re-enter the Activity explicitly; successful result queues the verdict exactly once.

avoidsSingleAutomaticCheck: Player explicitly chooses an approach before the Activity.
Activity success still does not auto-commit Return Home or even write prince-defeated until the authored verdict choice.
options.returnHomeSeparation: Verdict writes prince-defeated; Return Home becomes eligible afterward and remains a separate ending commit.
optionalSupportExamples: prelude can expose item/relationship-supported approach choices
Activity can reuse itemCapability-conditioned efficiency options
none of those supports are required for a baseline successful route
productionTouches: content/definitions.json: add one story action and one Activity definition
src/ui/app.ts: expose begin action and Palace Activity entry
focused cross-system save/reload + exactly-once verdict tests

B_QUEST_EVENT_CHAIN.stateTracking: quest stage + event queue/pending + prince-defeated fact

C_PRELUDE_ACTIVITY_VERDICT.implementationSurface: largest of the three but still existing systems only
C_PRELUDE_ACTIVITY_VERDICT.stateTracking: world facts + ActivityEnvelope + event queue/pending + prince-defeated fact

leaderDecisionQuestions: Should the confrontation feel primarily systemic (A), primarily authored/dramatic (B), or hybrid (C)?
Should failure return immediately to a retryable ready state, or require replaying a short prelude?
Should optional Palace relationship/item support alter only available choices, or also reduce Activity endurance cost/progress burden?
Should the final successful action write prince-defeated immediately (A/B) or require a separate authored verdict confirmation (C)?
explicitNonGoals: No Prince name, identity, personality, motive, or lore.
No final 3-stage vs 6-stage Palace career topology.
No change to D23 New Start+/Meta semantics.
No change to fixed all-12 >=91 True readiness.
No automatic Return Home commit on Prince defeat.
